messages:
Maria G: Morning triage — shifting cover for 10:30–14:30 UTC. Current queue 42 tickets, 6 P1s (billing x2, prod-embed error x3, auth flake x1). Pls ack if you can take the midday window.
Aj Patel: I can take 10:30–12:30, then need to hand off. I’ll own the billing P1s while there. :thumbsup:
Devon K: Taking 12:30–14:30. Also flagged customer ticket #3782 that needs escalation — reproduction shows embed API 503s when token count > 4k.
Priya S: Noted on #3782. I pushed a diagnostic macro to use for repros: 
```
Macro: /repro-embed-503
Steps: 1) send embed request with long doc (>4k tokens) 2) capture trace-id from response header 3) paste trace-id here
```
Please use that so we can correlate traces.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026 (embed 503 spike). Assigned to team: support + eng-runtime. Priority: High.
Josh R: I glanced at logs — appear to be a quota throttle from the serving layer on some nodes. Repro on staging similar traffic pattern. Putting a short runbook in #eng-runtime.
Lina M: Quick macro tweak suggestion: for billing P1s, use macro `/billing-refund-standard` but add note "probable duplicate charge" to speed finance path. I edited the macro name to `/billing-dup-refund` — link: https://console.redwood/macros/billing-dup-refund
Devon K: ack, using /billing-dup-refund for the two billing tickets. Also pinging @eng-runtime for the embed throttle — @Josh R can you add the node IDs to the INC?
Josh R: added node IDs and one sample trace-id. Also kicked a hot patch to bump per-node request soft-limit while we dig. No customer-facing rollback needed yet.
Maria G: Thanks. Small ask: code-review ping — PR 871 by @Priya S updates many macros (refactor + new param). If someone has 10 mins, can we get a quick review? blocking my macro sync work.
Priya S: PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/support-macros/pulls/871 — mostly renames + safety checks. 
Aj Patel: I’ll do quick pass now.
Lina M: Quick note from ops — watch for false positives on the billing macro when customers have multiple tokens; include the duplicate-charge check first.
Maria G: Hand-off plan: Aj -> Devon confirmed. If embed INC escalates beyond 1hr, route to oncall eng-runtime @oncall-runtime. Otherwise we'll keep within support.
Devon K: Taking midday handoff, will update #incidents with status every 15m.
Maria G: Perfect. If anyone sees a noisy customer, DM me and I’ll coordinate responses. Thanks all. :pray:
